subject: general
question: The product of two numbers is 2160 and their HCF is 12. One of the possible pairs of numbers is:
solution:
**Given:**

The product of two numbers is 2160

HCF = 12

**Concept Used:**

Product of two numbers = LCMtimes HCF

**Calculation:**

**2160=LCM×12**

**LCM=180**

**Let's check the LCM of the given options:**

1) (12, 184)

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/93ce0b101105705475e9fd54fde6883e419aa8f674ac6710c48f0414426392d0.png] 

 L.C.M = 2 times 2 ×2×3×23

= 552

2) (12, 185)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/465346f3cda9507604d5ca998e890c8e29a49601007467da7c574da559e2fa94.png] 

L.C.M = 2 times 2 ×3×5×37

= 2220

3) **(36, 60)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/93e523f425c6c865ad10c91335f8a2b37a52521ed21be35793923b8ab0784508.png] 

L.C.M = 2 times 2 ×3×3×5

= 180

4) (35, 60)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/23c152272019916f0c06a7b66cf033560ac6b5ee1569b7bd85409a1283434883.png] 

L.C.M = 2 times 2 ×3×5×7 

= 420

Hence, the possible pair of numbers to satisfy the condition is **(36, 60).**
